items.before: Before, a trader starting a live-animals notification gave the commodity details straight after choosing what they were importing, and gave the import reason later. Now the first run goes: origin of the import, what are you importing, main import reason, commodity details, identification details (when the animals need them), additional details, then arrival details. The end-to-end tests now walk this order for cattle by air and for a horse by sea.
items.after:
Before, a trader starting a live-animals notification gave the commodity details straight after choosing what they were importing.

They gave the import reason later.

Now the first run goes in this order:

- origin of the import
- what are you importing
- main import reason
- commodity details
- identification details (when the animals need them)
- additional details
- arrival details

The end-to-end tests now walk this order for:

- cattle by air
- a horse by sea

items.before: Before, the first run went from roles and addresses on to the county parish holding (CPH) number page for animals that need one. Now it goes straight to the contact address. The CPH number page opens only from its row on roles and addresses, and saving it returns there. If every task on the overview is already complete, roles and addresses goes to the overview instead.
items.after:
Before, the first run went from roles and addresses on to the county parish holding (CPH) number page, for animals that need one.

Now it goes straight to the contact address.

The CPH number page opens only from its row on roles and addresses.

Saving the CPH number returns to roles and addresses.

If every task on the overview is already complete, roles and addresses goes to the overview instead.

items.before: Before, the first run could finish on the overview. Now saving the contact address always opens the review, which lists anything still to do at the top and marks each unfinished card. In plants, Continue on the consignment contact page now opens check your answers even when the notification is unfinished, and Continue there shows the missing answers again instead of going to the overview. Plants keeps its own page order.
items.after:
Before, the first run could finish on the overview.

Now saving the contact address always opens the review. The review:

- lists anything still to do at the top
- marks each unfinished card

In plants:

- Continue on the consignment contact page now opens check your answers, even when the notification is unfinished
- Continue on check your answers shows the missing answers again, instead of going to the overview
- plants keeps its own page order

items.before: Before, opening a task from the overview and pressing 'Save and continue' carried the trader on through the next pages: main import reason on to additional details, arrival details on to transit countries, and roles and addresses on to the CPH number. Now each page opened from its overview task returns to the overview, and its task shows Complete when its answers are finished. Arrival details opened from a Change link on the review returns to the review. In plants, arrival details opened from the overview returns there instead of going on to the place of destination; plants tasks made of several pages still move through their own pages first.
items.after:
Before, a trader could open a task from the overview and press 'Save and continue'.

This carried them on through the next pages:

- main import reason on to additional details
- arrival details on to transit countries
- roles and addresses on to the CPH number

Now each page opened from its overview task returns to the overview.

Its task shows Complete when its answers are finished.

Arrival details opened from a Change link on the review returns to the review.

In plants:

- arrival details opened from the overview returns there, instead of going on to the place of destination
- plants tasks made of several pages still move through their own pages first

items.before: Before, Back on main import reason and on additional details always went to the overview. Now, during the first run, Back on the commodity page goes to origin, Back on main import reason goes to what are you importing, Back on commodity details goes to the commodity page, and Back on additional details goes to identification details (or to commodity details when no identification is needed). A page opened from the overview still has Back to the overview.
items.after:
Before, Back on these pages always went to the overview:

- main import reason
- additional details

Now, during the first run:

- Back on the commodity page goes to origin
- Back on main import reason goes to what are you importing
- Back on commodity details goes to the commodity page
- Back on additional details goes to identification details (or to commodity details when no identification is needed)

A page opened from the overview still has Back to the overview.

items.before: Before, 'Save and return to overview' ran the page's required-answer checks, so a trader could not leave a half-finished page. Now it saves whatever was entered and returns to the overview with no error, and the task does not show Complete. This applies on origin, what are you importing, main import reason, identification details, additional details, arrival details, transit countries, transport details, upload documents and roles and addresses, and on the plants pages. Commodity details and the contact address still check their answers before saving.
items.after:
Before, 'Save and return to overview' ran the page's required-answer checks.

This meant a trader could not leave a half-finished page.

Now it saves whatever was entered and returns to the overview with no error.

The task does not show Complete.

This applies on these pages:

- origin
- what are you importing
- main import reason
- identification details
- additional details
- arrival details
- transit countries
- transport details
- upload documents
- roles and addresses
- the plants pages

These pages still check their answers before saving:

- commodity details
- the contact address

items.before: An answer that breaks its own format rule is still refused, even on 'Save and return to overview': for example an impossible arrival date such as 31/2/2027, a region code that is not valid, or an exit date that is not a real date. The page shows that answer's error and nothing on the page is saved. In plants the same applies to a date that is not real, a future date once the goods have arrived, a time not on the 24-hour clock, a port not on the list or a quantity that is not a whole number.
items.after:
An answer that breaks its own format rule is still refused, even on 'Save and return to overview'.

For example:

- an impossible arrival date, such as 31/2/2027
- a region code that is not valid
- an exit date that is not a real date

The page shows that answer's error.

Nothing on the page is saved.

In plants, the same applies to:

- a date that is not real
- a future date once the goods have arrived
- a time not on the 24-hour clock
- a port not on the list
- a quantity that is not a whole number
